title: Russian Family Visa (Private Visa) from the UK
description: Russian family visa, officially a private visa, for visiting family or friends: the official invitation, documents, visa length and how we help.
h1: Russian family visa from the UK
intro: The Russian family visa, known officially as a private visa, is for visiting relatives or friends in Russia. Your host arranges an official invitation for you. We prepare your application and check every detail matches.
eligibility: You are visiting a relative or friend who lives in Russia
Your host has arranged an official invitation for you
You have travel medical insurance valid in Russia

sections.heading: UK government travel advice
sections.text: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) currently advises against all travel to Russia. If you travel against this advice, your travel insurance may not be valid, and the UK's ability to help you in Russia is very limited. Please read the [latest FCDO advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia) before you book.

sections.heading: How the Russian family visa invitation works
sections.text: Your relative or friend in Russia applies for your invitation through their local migration office. It can take several weeks, so ask them to start early. When it's ready, they send it to you and we use it for your application.

sections.heading: How long is a Russian private visa?
sections.text: Private visas are usually single or double entry for up to 90 days, matching the dates on your invitation.

sections.heading: Russian family visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help with Russian family visa applications for clients across the UK. Most applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.

sections.heading: How long is a Russian family visa?
sections.text: A Russian family visa is usually single or double entry, for up to 90 days, matching the dates on your invitation. Your host should apply for the invitation several weeks before you plan to travel.

faqs.a: Your host in Russia, at their local migration office.

faqs.q: Can my host just write a letter instead?
faqs.a: No. A private visa needs the official invitation, not a personal letter.

faqs.q: Does the UK government advise against travel to Russia?
faqs.a: Yes. The FCDO currently advises against all travel to Russia. Check the latest advice on GOV.UK before making plans.
